_doc: Add to global.SPOIL_NEVER in content/spoilage/kubejs/startup_scripts/spoilage/rates.js and to spoilBlacklist in config/spoiled-common.toml. None of these are food; fuels and machines do not rot. Fuel buckets stored cold or warm keep as is.
note: Ethanol and plant oil are the only crop-derived goods; they are treated as stable (sealed fuel). If a decay model is wanted later, plant_oil at 3 percent a week as grain would match.
